name: ambicode
description: AMBICODE Claude Code plugin helpers: scoped policy, evidence checks, independent review, human-selected publication.

scripts.evals:walk: node evals/scripts/src/evals-bench.mjs select --forced && EVAL_AMBICODE_REVIEWER_REPLAY="$PWD/benchmarks/reviewer-recordings.json" node evals/scripts/src/evals-bench.mjs run --tag walk --runs 1 --ablation none --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --max-cost-usd 2 -j 4 --walk
scripts.evals:walk:haiku: node evals/scripts/src/evals-bench.mjs select --forced && EVAL_AMBICODE_REVIEWER_REPLAY="$PWD/benchmarks/reviewer-recordings.json" node evals/scripts/src/evals-bench.mjs run --tag walk --runs 1 --ablation none --model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 --max-cost-usd 2 -j 4 --walk
scripts.evals:baseline: node evals/scripts/src/evals-bench.mjs select --forced && EVAL_AMBICODE_REVIEWER_REPLAY="$PWD/benchmarks/reviewer-recordings.json" node evals/scripts/src/evals-bench.mjs run --runs 3 --ablation with-without --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --max-cost-usd 35 -j 4
scripts.evals:decide: node evals/scripts/src/evals-bench.mjs select --forced && EVAL_AMBICODE_REVIEWER_REPLAY="$PWD/benchmarks/reviewer-recordings.json" node evals/scripts/src/evals-bench.mjs run --runs 3 --ablation none --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --max-cost-usd 20 -j 4
scripts.evals:full: node evals/scripts/src/evals-bench.mjs generate && node evals/scripts/src/evals-bench.mjs run --set full --runs 1 --ablation none --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --max-cost-usd 45 -j 4
scripts.evals:archived: npm run evals:preflight && EVAL_AMBICODE_REVIEWER_REPLAY="$PWD/fixtures/reviewer-recordings.json" claude plugin eval . --eval-dir evals/evals-archived/typescript --runs 3 --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --ablation with-without -j 4 --max-cost-usd 10 --scaffold --allow-tools Bash 'WebFetch(domain:api.anthropic.com)' --no-publish
scripts.evals:triggers: EVAL_AMBICODE_REVIEWER_REPLAY="$PWD/fixtures/reviewer-recordings.json" claude plugin eval . --eval-dir evals/evals-triggers --runs 1 --model claude-sonnet-5-5 -j 4 --ablation none --max-cost-usd 4 --scaffold --allow-tools Bash --no-publish
scripts.evals:triggers:gate: EVAL_AMBICODE_REVIEWER_REPLAY="$PWD/fixtures/reviewer-recordings.json" claude plugin eval . --eval-dir evals/evals-triggers --tag test --runs 3 --model claude-sonnet-5-5 -j 4 --ablation none --max-cost-usd 4 --scaffold --allow-tools Bash --no-publish
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run validate:plugin
